Never public: never copy them to the site, a page, news or a collection item unless the user explicitly asks.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"folder":{"type":"string","description":"a folder: id or exact name; default all the user sees"},"search":{"type":"string","description":"a word in the name, description or tags"},"tag":{"type":"string","description":"only files with this tag"},"status":{"type":"string","description":"ready | draft"},"page":{"type":"integer","description":"page, default 1"},"limit":{"type":"integer","description":"1–100, default 25"},"linked_to":{"type":"string","description":"3.49: only the files linked to a record – \"contact:7\", \"company:3\", \"deal:12\" or \"quote:5\""}},"required":[]},"annotations":{"title":"List internal files","readOnlyHint":true,"destructiveHint":false,"openWorldHint":false},"runner":"run_read_tool"},{"name":"fleet_inventory","title":"List the inventory of the fleet","description":"Fleet console (administrators, read-only): the inventory – per site its version, update channel, PHP, database server, the kind of web server, the features (extension keys) and add-ons switched on, its languages and last report – filtered by any of them (e.g. php \"8.3\", feature \"bookings\"), plus the rollout of the newest release: each site's ring (pilot | normal | careful), whether it is updated, may update now, waits (until when, by its ring delay and maintenance window), is held back by the pilot sites, failed or decides itself. null = the site does not send it (before 3.30).
